name: Interdimensional Girl (From Outer Space)
source:
An interdimensional girl crash landed in my garden last night, she was quiet and polite. She didn't yell and she didn't argue, she took up barely any space at all... So I invited her in, and slowly but gradually, she felt less like an interdimensional girl and more like just a girl, who was lonely.

[From [url=https://lonesomejester.itch.io/interdimensional-girl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
昨晚，一个异次元女孩坠毁在我的花园里，她很安静，很有礼貌。她没有大喊大叫，她没有争辩，她几乎不占任何空间……所以我邀请她进来，慢慢地但逐渐地，她觉得自己不再像一个跨维度的女孩，而更像一个孤独的女孩。

[来自[url=https://lonesomejester.itch.io/interdimensional-girl]itch.io[/url]]
